title: Resolve Open Question 4 and make AC15 definitive
text: Resolve Open Question 4 and make AC15 definitive. The measured-tier threshold and adjudication requirement are still provisional, leaving the acceptance criterion and evidence-tier transition dependent on an unresolved product decision.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in e8485e6, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head.
